comparison.interpretation: Baseline gaps describe the unchanged baseline only. Current coverage is independently reported against repaired working-tree inputs; baseline gaps are not current required-check failures.

inspector.note: This is a retrospective census, not a claim that the hardened checker existed or ran at the baseline revision.

limitations: Source coverage is distinct from local, finished-image, CI and live evidence; this command neither executes proof commands nor grants provider authority.
Historical accepted artifacts are references only and are never rewritten by this inventory.

Two acceptance-route-validator-invalid findings are input-compatibility errors: the archived acceptance inspector defines inspect(scope_contract, root=ROOT, command_root=None), while the current declaration census calls inspect(..., probe_commands=False). No acceptance command ran. These do not prove the historical acceptance gate failed; those two nested acceptance checks remain unavailable for this retrospective census.
report_method: current hardened independent census applied to immutable baseline source snapshot

declarations.expectation: Node 22 build image and distroless non-root Node 22 runtime image.
ImageUri accepts only a repository digest reference.
The publisher resolves and records the image digest.
Default server port is 3000 and health exposure is configuration controlled.
Task container port is 3000 and container health uses /livez.
The mounted platform-smoke app declares PLATFORM_SMOKE_APP_NAME as required configuration.
ECS deployment circuit breaker and rollback are enabled.
Previous task-definition/image rollback target and rollback runbook are named.

excludes: PostgreSQL relational persistence and Stage 6 operations
worker, relay, queue, and outbox execution
Cognito client provisioning and negative-authorization proof
public ingress, WAF, DNS, and TLS configuration
observability delivery, alarms, SLO coverage, and cost controls

snapshot_provenance.blob_verification: Every archived tracked file content matches the git ls-tree blob object; regular-file permissions match recorded 100644/100755 mode.
